story_info.title: Penny Penguin's Sparkly Teeth
story_info.subtitle: A happy start to a healthy Saturday!
story_info.moral: Brushing your teeth every day helps keep them strong and clean.

main_character.name: Penny Penguin
main_character.appearance: Penny is a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet. She has rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance.

slides.title: A Sunny Saturday Morning
slides.text: Tick-tock! The morning sun peeked into Penny Penguin's cozy igloo. It was a bright, sunny Saturday! Penny stretched her shiny black flippers. She yawned a tiny yawn. Her orange feet wiggled under the warm blanket. 'Time for a super happy day!' Penny chirped. She knew a secret. Healthy habits make every day fun!
slides.speaker_notes: Penny Penguin wakes up cheerfully on a Saturday morning in her cozy igloo.

slides.title: Remembering a Healthy Habit
slides.text: Penny hopped out of her soft bed. She wanted to run and play! But then she paused. She remembered a healthy morning habit. Her teeth needed a good cleaning. Penny loved her shiny white teeth. They helped her eat yummy berries and fish. Strong, clean teeth are very important for a happy smile!
slides.speaker_notes: Penny remembers her teeth need brushing before she starts her day.

slides.title: Ready to Sparkle
slides.text: Penny waddled to her small bathroom. She grabbed her bright blue toothbrush. It had soft, friendly bristles. She squeezed a tiny dollop of yummy mint toothpaste. Splat! Penny looked in the mirror and made a funny face. 'Time to brush, brush, brush!' she sang. Her teeth were ready for sparkle!
slides.speaker_notes: Penny gets her toothbrush and toothpaste, ready to make brushing fun.

slides.title: Brush, Brush, Brush!
slides.text: Up and down, round and round! Penny brushed all her teeth. She brushed the top ones. She brushed the bottom ones. She even brushed the ones at the back. Her little flippers moved quickly. She brushed for two whole minutes. Good job, Penny!
slides.speaker_notes: Penny diligently brushes all her teeth for a full two minutes.

slides.title: Clean and Ready!
slides.text: Rinse, rinse, rinse! Penny took a big gulp of water. She swished it all around. Then she spit it out. Her mouth felt so fresh and clean! Penny smiled wide. Her teeth sparkled brightly. 'Healthy habits make every day fun!' she cheered. Now, she was ready for a wonderful Saturday!
slides.speaker_notes: Penny feels happy and refreshed with her clean teeth, ready for the day.
